title: Connected Groups With Union-Find

visible.label: Union merges components and decrements count
visible.script:
uf = UnionFind(4)
assert uf.count == 4
assert uf.union(0, 1) is True and uf.count == 3
assert uf.union(2, 3) is True and uf.count == 2
assert uf.connected(0, 3) is False
assert uf.union(1, 2) is True and uf.count == 1
assert uf.connected(0, 3) is True

visible.label: Redundant union returns False without changing count
visible.script:
uf = UnionFind(3)
assert uf.union(0, 1) is True
assert uf.union(0, 1) is False
assert uf.count == 2

hidden.label: Self-union and self-connected
hidden.script:
uf = UnionFind(3)
assert uf.connected(1, 1) is True
assert uf.union(1, 1) is False
assert uf.count == 3

hidden.label: Find returns canonical root per component
hidden.script:
uf = UnionFind(5)
uf.union(0, 4)
uf.union(4, 2)
assert uf.find(0) == uf.find(2) == uf.find(4)
assert uf.find(1) != uf.find(0)

hidden.label: Disjoint chains merge cleanly
hidden.script:
uf = UnionFind(6)
uf.union(0, 1); uf.union(1, 2)
uf.union(3, 4); uf.union(4, 5)
assert uf.count == 2
uf.union(2, 3)
assert uf.count == 1
assert uf.connected(0, 5) is True

hidden.label: Large chain path-compression performance (10,000 nodes)

hints: Keep parent = list(range(n)), rank = [0] * n, and self.count = n.
In find(x), apply iterative or recursive path compression: while parent[x] != x: parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]; x = parent[x]. In union(a, b), attach the shallower rank root under the taller root!
